title: Automatic instrumentation, and where it stops being enough

videos.script: Look again at the orders service. It has no tracer, no spans, no OpenTelemetry setup. And yet lesson 1's trace had four spans from it. {{orders}} They came from a wrapper. The service starts under a command called opentelemetry-instrument, which patches the libraries orders uses before orders runs. {{wrapper}} In this lesson you open that wrapper. You see which libraries it patched, what each one records, and how to steer it with environment variables alone. {{env}} Then you find its edges. A trace that breaks in two at the queue. A span that knows the route but not the order. {{edges}} You fix one of them with a single line of your own code. And you measure what the wrapper costs, on three hundred real orders. {{cost}}
